facts.value: An industry is the whole of all economic activities by companies, people, and organizations involved in the production of goods and services for a particular field.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The pizza industry includes all producers who make and sell pizza.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: A person cooking pizza at home for their children wouldn't fit under this description as they're not selling any products or services.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The steel mill is part of the industrial sector because it involves the mass production of raw materials essential for other industries.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The car manufacturing plant is considered industrial because it produces vehicles on a large scale, utilizing assembly lines and heavy machinery.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The industrial sector encompasses a wide range of activities, from manufacturing and construction to energy production and transportation.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: The term 'industrial' can also refer to the type of building or area, such as an industrial park or industrial complex, which is typically used for factories, warehouses, and other facilities dedicated to large-scale production or heavy industries.
facts.programme_association: Industrial Biochemistry - BSc | University of Limerick
